contact_penalty_diagnostic.interpretation: Independent stiffness-scale diagnostic only; not a reproduction of the unpublished nonlinear contact iteration.

P44_D001_probe.observation: The paragraph introducing Figures 7 and 8 states 4.06 s and 2.32 s, while the figure captions state 0.58 s and 1.74 s. Figure 2 also uses 0.58 s and 1.74 s. EngiProof preserves both source statements without deciding which is intended.

source_review.source: P44 Figures 7–9 and accompanying text, printed pages 535–536
observations: Positive contact force denotes contact on the right side and negative force denotes contact on the left.
For the example, the maximum contact force occurs in the flexible-joint region and is stated to be almost twice the maximum force inside the well.
Figure 9 is described as sinusoidal-like but low-resolution because only ten time points were used.
The source states that drillstring stiffness contributes less than 3% of the original contact force inside the well in the gravity-removal check.

evidence_boundary: Equation (1), table values, K1 and figure labels are PUBLISHED. Section-property arithmetic, exact-trigonometric Eq1 calculation, time-step arithmetic and penalty-penetration scale are INDEPENDENT. Full nonlinear FE contact-force profiles are not reproduced because the paper does not supply the complete well/riser geometry and time-dependent wall-displacement dataset.
